stage3f.rule: Stage 3G reads these; it never rewrites a Stage 3F artifact, certificate, hash, fact, the Decision Evaluation Contract, authority or the expert roster. A Stage 3G result that bears on a frozen fact is reported as new Stage 3G evidence, never as an edit of the fact.

hypotheses.H1_LEVEL_COVERAGE: Full-curriculum fitting closes the high-level gap without future information.
hypotheses.H2_DEPLOYABLE_SEARCH: Certified deterministic action effects capture most known-search value.
hypotheses.H3_ENVIRONMENT_DYNAMICS_VALUE: The known/deployable gap bounds environment decision value; matched ablations isolate attribution.
hypotheses.H5_NO_WORLD_MODEL_NEED: If observable fitting/search closes residual, learned world-model work remains unjustified.

seeds.admission: Unmodified corpusRecord; canonical objectives > roles > shape order, 190 admitted per (family, level, H0-H4) cell; every 25th candidate D4 audited. Exclude record/world/topology hashes of all prior stages and open fits.
seeds.ood: B is independent seed-family OOD crossed with all levels; known compositions. No claim of unseen-mechanism/structural OOD.

actionModel.unknownRule: Never replace UNKNOWN with simulator truth or assume no reaction. Keep certified action effects in a separate conditional projection; actual next health/service/position/legality and every unavailable magnitude remain UNKNOWN.
actionModel.continuation: Exhaustive MOVE/WAIT action-effect envelope over the observed reference map, avoiding observed blockers. Future branches are conditional on unknown legality and actor survival. No future target actions are invented. No RETREAT tie-break is needed: all spatial neighbours are enumerated.
actionModel.depthMeaning: root action then d conditional navigation actions (same convention as Stage 3G.4)
actionModel.scoring: Fixed conditional-logit scorer fitted on open labels; root observable representation plus bounded envelope columns. No simulator reward, oracle, rollout or privileged scalar is a deployable scoring input.

plan.knownUpperBound: Stage 3G.4 searchValues, unchanged; KNOWN_D2/D3 are level-balanced linear root features + relative privileged cumulative scalar; raw argmax planners also reported. Depth3 is every 16th eligible row; paired comparisons use exactly this same subsample.
plan.deployableSearch: Linear root features + bounded certified action-effect envelope. Unknown futures retained; conditional paths are not E1 successor-world facts.

rules.material: Paired optimal-set-hit gain >= 0.05; deterministic 2000-resample bootstrap 95% lower CI > 0; normalised regret not worse (frozen materialGain).
rules.primary: LEVEL_BALANCED_LINEAR; interaction is a fixed capacity diagnostic, no selection on sealed data, no nonlinear fit/promotion.
rules.matched: Each d comparison uses label horizon h with h+1 > d+1. D2 primary on PARTIAL_3; D3 secondary on PARTIAL_4; ALL unguarded results descriptive only. Depths 0-2 on all eligible rows; matched depth3 on every 16th eligible row per family/open fit, fixed before sealing.
rules.horizonDependent: PARTIAL_3 rows with at least one optimal candidate absent from immediate scalar top set; audit label only.
rules.highGap: LB - frozen material in HIGH in each family AND no material KNOWN_D2 - LB on guarded HIGH in either family.
rules.primaryReplicated: LB - frozen material in HIGH in both families with significant normalised-regret decrease.
rules.sufficient: no material KNOWN_D2 - DEPLOYABLE_D2 in ALL, MID, HIGH or RETREAT in either independent family; requires at least 100 guarded retreat rows/family, otherwise NOT_TESTABLE.
rules.environmentMaterial: KNOWN_D2 - DEPLOYABLE_D2 material in same ALL/MID/HIGH/RETREAT stratum in A and B AND KNOWN_D2 - NO_ENV_D2 (same known scorer, only dynamics changed) material in same stratum in both families with >=20% relative regret reduction, normalised regret CI upper <0 and n>=100 per family. Raw deployable/known gap alone is an upper bound, not causal attribution.
rules.ood: environmentMaterial gate replicates in seed-family B; does not demonstrate unseen-mechanism OOD.
rules.retreatClassification: Coverage flag: LB-frozen material on RETREAT both families. Action-model flag: NO_ENV_D2-DEPLOYABLE_D2 material both (private action/value/surface residual; attribution-qualified). Environment flag: matched dynamics gate on RETREAT both. One flag -> named limitation; multiple -> RETREAT_MIXED; none -> INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. No retreat repair.
rules.transition: environmentMaterial and OOD_STABLE and deployable sufficient !== true and all integrity tests pass.
rules.worldModel: transition gate AND deterministic observable/action-search alternatives ruled out AND meaningful matched regret reduction in both families AND genuinely unavailable mechanisms. Navigation-only search cannot rule out all deterministic target-action alternatives; this final gate remains false.
rules.deterministicAlternatives: The conditional navigation-only continuation does not exhaust every deterministic target-action planner. Therefore learned-world-model need is NOT_ESTABLISHED in this stage even if the forecasting gate passes; run a full E1 action-surface sufficiency audit before a world-model claim.
rules.oracle: Temporal capability required only when transition gate passes; no evidence about existing Oracle expert fitness or architectural placement.
rules.retreatSpecialist: Environment value concentrated in retreat only if retreat gate passes AND NON_RETREAT has no replicated dynamics gap AND >=80% of positive paired raw regret reduction lies on retreat-optimal rows.
rules.attribution: HOSTILE_ATTACK and HAZARD_DAMAGE: leave-one-mechanism-out interventions at all steps, paired decisions/regret with fixed known scorer. SERVICE_REVERSAL/ENTITY_STATE_CHANGE/RESOURCE_STATE_CHANGE/OTHER: observational root event strata, co-occurring and non-additive; never causal credit. G5 audit is offline only.

plan.fitting: Frozen Stage3G3_LINEAR refit on original DEV, hash must match; LB and every depth fit on fresh OPEN seed6012 L0-L7 with fixed logit settings (2000 iterations, lr.1, l2.001). No CAL tuning.

evaluationContract.CAD: Weighted residual fraction where known D2 scalar strictly separates optimal from chosen incorrect candidates, privileged
evaluationContract.CR: paired raw/normalised regret and relative reduction
evaluationContract.DDV: Deployable scorer/search measured against LB; known-search comparisons PRIVILEGED_UPPER_BOUND

plan.freeze: All evaluation source, schema, specification, tests, package scripts, plan, open report and fit manifest committed before sealed generation. Refuse second sealed generation/evaluation except read-only reproduction.
plan.reproducibility: Canonical numerics, full repository suites, all inherited checks, 2 x --check, fresh-clone fit+sealed payload rebuild and certificate check; no tracked writes in --check.
